summary.headline: Added Emergency Shark Siren one-press evacuation trigger to Mitigation Panel
summary.detail: Added the `Emergency Shark Siren` button wired to `triggerSiren()` as a new step in the protocol, broadcasting a zone-wide evacuation siren and flipping the zone status pill from Clear to Siren active. The runbook designates this control as the primary evacuation trigger, giving lifeguards a single prominent action to clear all zones immediately.

contextRefs.excerpt: **The primary evacuation trigger is the Emergency Shark Siren button on the SURF Mitigation Panel.** 1. Open the SURF console app. 2.
